text:
maria: Quick heads-up — release window tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need coordinated bumps across api -> runtime -> console -> sdk. Target versions: api v1.9.0, runtime v0.15.0-rc2, console v3.4.1, sdk v2.2.0. Please confirm PRs/tags and any migration notes.

jon: I opened runtime PR #4821 (adds kv-cache header + small perf tweak). Ready for review, aiming to merge today.

vik: API PR #1278 merged to main earlier but we didn't tag. I'll create the v1.9.0 tag after CI green and push. ETA 30m.

cheng: Console needs a tiny schema tweak to parse the new header. I'll prepare PR against console/main once runtime tag exists — don't want it referencing an untagged artifact.

kat: I'll nudge the changelog owners. Can someone add a one-line release note for runtime PR? e.g., "runtime: expose kv-cache eviction stats (opt-in)"

maria: Yes please add that to #4821, kat. Also: checklist below — reply with ✅ when done.
- [ ] API tag pushed (v1.9.0)
- [ ] Runtime merged + tag (v0.15.0-rc2)
- [ ] Console PR created referencing runtime tag
- [ ] SDK bump and docs update
- [ ] Changelog lines added

jon: ✅ runtime PR merged. tagging now.

ops-bot: build/runtime-artifacts:v0.15.0-rc2 published to internal registry (sha: a3f7d1c)

vik: ✅ pushed v1.9.0 tag for api (org/repo@v1.9.0) — pushed to origin.

cheng: Creating console PR now. Draft at #930, will switch to ready-for-review once it points to v0.15.0-rc2.

kat: Added changelog entries: runtime (#4821) and api (#1278). Kept SDK note as TODO until sdk PR lands.

maria: Two questions: 1) Do we need a runtime minor bump (not just rc) for compatibility matrix? 2) Any reason SDK cannot be bumped immediately after console PR?

jon: 1) Yes, runtime bump is needed because of header contract change. We should communicate to partners. 2) SDK can be bumped once console release candidate is validated — it reads header changes; if we bump SDK earlier some customers might see missing fields.

vik: SDK PR in progress — I'll open one that pins to api@v1.9.0 and runtime@v0.15.0-rc2 and includes migration note. Should be ready in ~45m.

maria: Good. Ops note: if any of the tags change after push (force), call it out here and ping @release-bot. We want full reproducibility.

release-bot: Reminder: cut window scheduled 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z. If critical blockers remain after 2026-03-18T14:00:00Z we'll consider patch-only hotfix.

cheng: Console PR #930 now references v0.15.0-rc2 and is ready-for-review. Added migration note in PR body.

vik: Opened SDK PR #221 — pins to api v1.9.0 & runtime v0.15.0-rc2 and updates README example.

kat: ✅ changelog complete for all four components.

maria: Awesome. Final pre-cut checklist: all checks green? If yes we'll proceed with the cut. If any one of api/runtime/console/sdks has failing e2e we hold and triage.

jon: e2e failing on a flaky test unrelated to the change. I'll rerun; if it flakes again we'll tag a new rc and update PRs.

vik: All CI green on api + sdk.

ops-bot: e2e pipeline rerun triggered by @jon — pipeline #789 queued.

maria: Thanks all — please ping here with any last-minute tags/force pushes. I'll post a formal cut note in #announcements once cut completes. :thumbsup:

kat: one last note — add a short migration blurb to release notes: "Clients reading runtime headers should tolerate missing kv-cache fields for one release cycle." Added to SDK PR.

jon: rerun succeeded, e2e green. No need for new rc.

maria: ✅ cutting. I'll wait 5m for any objections.

vik: no objections, go ahead.

cheng: go for it.

release-bot: Release cut started: coordinating tags and changelogs across repos. Logs: https://internal.release/logs/2061012345

maria: Done — all tags pushed and release artifacts published. Posting final checklist to #announcements now. Thanks everyone! :tada:
